welcome.title: Welcome to Joidy
welcome.content: Your personal knowledge management system with gamification. Here you'll take notes, set goals, and grow a plant while keeping daily streaks.

notes.title: Create your first note
notes.content: On the Notes page you can create and organize your knowledge. Each note supports tags, icons, and colors, and syncs with your Obsidian vault.

tags.title: Tags and graph
tags.content: Tag your notes to connect them. The Graph visualizes how your notes relate through tags, revealing patterns and themes in your knowledge.

goals.title: Your first goal
goals.content: Set goals with timeframes (daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly). Completing goals gives you XP and fuels your progress. Start with something small and achievable.

streaks.title: Streaks and plant
streaks.content: Keep a daily activity streak. Every day you interact with Joidy you earn XP and your plant grows: from seed to tree. Don't break the chain!

obsidian.title: Connect Obsidian (optional)
obsidian.content: Joidy syncs with your Obsidian vault to keep your notes in Markdown format. You can set it up now from Settings, or skip this step and do it later.

streakPanel.title: Streaks & habits
streakPanel.rateHint: check-ins done vs. expected across your active habits

consistency.title: How it's calculated
consistency.body: Each cell is a day; its shade follows the XP earned, split into 5 levels (quantiles) so one huge day cannot wash out the rest. The weekly bars sum XP per ISO week; their brightness shows how many of the 7 days were active.

trend.title: How it's calculated
trend.body: The 7-day average smooths daily spikes. The dashed line is a linear regression (least squares): if it climbs, your pace is improving. It is compared with the previous window of equal length; changes under 5% count as stable.

seasonality.title: How it's calculated
seasonality.body: XP earned is grouped by hour and weekday. The clock sums every week into 24 hours; the matrix keeps each weekday. Dayparts split XP into 6-hour blocks. Penalties are not counted.

mood.title: How it's calculated
mood.body: Your daily mood (1–5) is paired with that day's XP. Pearson's correlation (r) runs from −1 to 1: near 0 means no clear relationship. At least 3 logged days are needed; more data makes it more reliable.

goals.title: How it's calculated
goals.body: The funnel counts goals per lifecycle stage. Effectiveness is completed ÷ (completed + failed): only goals that were already decided count. If there are none, average progress is shown instead.

github.title: How it's calculated
github.body: With a token, your contributions per ISO week (commits, PRs and issues opened, reviews) over the last 12 weeks are queried, plus repos, languages and merged PRs. With a username only, your recent public events (max 300) are used. Without an account, webhooks.
